newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan M-2 rose 0.96 pct in week to Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan M-2 rose 0.96 pct in week to Dec 27.

text.p: Venezuelan money supply, as measured by the monetary aggregate M-2, rose 0.96 percent, or 51 billion bolivars, to 5.357 trillion bolivars in the week to December 27, the Central Bank said on Friday.
At the beginning of 1996, M-2 was 3.530 trillion bolivars.
Meanwhile, the monetary base rose 3.36 percent, or 54 billion bolivars, to 1.666 trillion bolivars in the same week to December 27. It stood at 873 billion bolivars at the start of 1996.
